title: Organization invitation mail ignores the request locale: a zh-CN inviter sends an English invitation while verification mails are localized
body:
## Source

objectstack-ai/cloud#2435 item 6, observed in both 2026-09-28 cloud end-to-end runs: cloud `96eb092f`, first at framework pin `bdea10a1`, then at objectstack `main` `862b6ce8`. Epic objectstack-ai/cloud#2440.

## What happens

A zh-CN user invites a colleague from the cloud console. The invitation mail comes out in English:
- subject `林悦 invited you to 悦来商贸`;
- body `林悦 (linyue@example.com) invited you to join 悦来商贸 on ObjectOS Cloud. Accept: …`.

On the same stack and the same day, the verification mail sent to the same user is Chinese (「验证您的 ObjectOS Cloud 邮箱地址」). objectstack#14319 / #14591 made auth mails pick their language from Accept-Language.

## Not measured

The mechanism is not measured. It is unknown whether the invitation template lacks a zh variant, or whether the invite path does not pass the inviter's request locale to the mail renderer (`plugin-email` auth templates / better-auth organization `sendInvitationEmail`). The invitee's own locale is unknown at send time; the inviter's request language is the available signal.

## Acceptance

1. With a zh-CN request, the invitation subject and body render in Chinese.
2. English stays the default.
3. A test pins the locale choice for the invitation mail.
